planets.name: TOI-421 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-421 with a 5.2-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-421 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-421. Its orbit and size follow Krenn et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
